overlappingRanges.label: lower track initial preview reveal native control hit is blocked
overlappingRanges.inference: Both temporal centers lie inside the other range, so paint-order changes cannot make both centers independently reachable in the same vertical band. Planner prescribed collision-packed annotation lanes below the unchanged content rail.

assetProvenance: The MCP build refreshes the cover bundle, not the complete viewer assets served by SOURCE. Every subsequent SOURCE and qualification command explicitly rebuilds packages/relic-viewer first.
